description_en: Queries detailed configurations about a virtual private cloud (VPC) direct connection of a dedicated resource group
description_zh: 查看专属资源组VPC直连配置详情
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-resource-dlink --cluster-id cn-shanghai --resource-id eas-r-adfabas0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceDLink

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the resource group belongs
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. For more information about how to query the ID of a resource group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的ID。如何查询资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412133.html
parameters.name: resource_id

AuxVSwitchList.description_en: The IDs of the secondary vSwitches that are directly connected

items.description_en: The ID of the secondary vSwitch

DestinationCIDRs.description_en: The CIDR blocks of the clients that you want to connect to. After this parameter is specified, the CIDR blocks are added to the back-to-origin route of the server. Either this parameter or the VSwitchIdList parameter can be used to determine CIDR blocks
DestinationCIDRs.description_zh: 要打通的客户端的网段信息，会将该网段加入到服务端的回包路由中
DestinationCIDRs.title_en: 要打通的客户端的网段信息，会将该网段加入到服务端的回包路由中，与VSwitchIdList可二选一
DestinationCIDRs.title_zh: 要打通的客户端的网段信息，会将该网段加入到服务端的回包路由中，与VSwitchIdList可二选一

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group that is directly connected

VSwitchId.description_en: The ID of the primary vSwitch that is directly connected

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC that is directly connected
